# qiroex v1.0.0 - Table of Contents

Pure-Elixir QR code generator with zero dependencies — SVG, PNG, and terminal output with styling and logo support.

## Pages

- [README](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Qiroex](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.md): Pure-Elixir QR code generation library with zero dependencies.
- [Qiroex.BackgroundImage](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.BackgroundImage.md): Background image configuration for SVG QR rendering.
- [Qiroex.Encoder.Alphanumeric](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Encoder.Alphanumeric.md): Alphanumeric mode encoder for QR codes.
- [Qiroex.Encoder.Byte](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Encoder.Byte.md): Byte mode encoder for QR codes.
- [Qiroex.Encoder.Kanji](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Encoder.Kanji.md): Kanji mode encoder for QR codes.
- [Qiroex.Encoder.Mode](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Encoder.Mode.md): Mode detection and auto-selection for QR code encoding.
- [Qiroex.Encoder.Numeric](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Encoder.Numeric.md): Numeric mode encoder for QR codes.
- [Qiroex.Encoder.Segment](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Encoder.Segment.md): Segment assembly for QR code data encoding.
- [Qiroex.ErrorCorrection.BCH](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.ErrorCorrection.BCH.md): BCH (Bose-Chaudhuri-Hocquenghem) encoding for QR code format and version information.
- [Qiroex.ErrorCorrection.GaloisField](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.ErrorCorrection.GaloisField.md): Galois Field GF(2⁸) arithmetic for QR code Reed-Solomon error correction.
- [Qiroex.ErrorCorrection.ReedSolomon](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.ErrorCorrection.ReedSolomon.md): Reed-Solomon error correction encoding for QR codes.
- [Qiroex.Logo](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Logo.md): Logo embedding configuration and geometry for QR codes.
- [Qiroex.Matrix](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Matrix.md): QR code matrix data structure.
- [Qiroex.Matrix.Builder](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Matrix.Builder.md): Places all function patterns onto the QR code matrix.
- [Qiroex.Matrix.DataPlacer](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Matrix.DataPlacer.md): Places encoded data bits into the QR code matrix using the
ISO 18004 two-column upward/downward snake pattern.
- [Qiroex.Matrix.Mask](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Matrix.Mask.md): QR code data masking.
- [Qiroex.Matrix.Regions](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Matrix.Regions.md): Classifies QR code matrix modules into functional regions.
- [Qiroex.Payload](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Payload.md): Behaviour and shared utilities for QR code payload builders.
- [Qiroex.Payload.Bitcoin](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Payload.Bitcoin.md): Bitcoin payment payload builder.
- [Qiroex.Payload.Email](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Payload.Email.md): Email payload builder.
- [Qiroex.Payload.Geo](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Payload.Geo.md): Geographic location payload builder.
- [Qiroex.Payload.MeCard](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Payload.MeCard.md): MeCard contact payload builder.
- [Qiroex.Payload.Phone](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Payload.Phone.md): Phone call payload builder.
- [Qiroex.Payload.SMS](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Payload.SMS.md): SMS payload builder.
- [Qiroex.Payload.URL](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Payload.URL.md): URL payload builder.
- [Qiroex.Payload.VCard](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Payload.VCard.md): vCard contact payload builder.
- [Qiroex.Payload.VEvent](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Payload.VEvent.md): Calendar event (vEvent) payload builder.
- [Qiroex.Payload.WhatsApp](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Payload.WhatsApp.md): WhatsApp message payload builder.
- [Qiroex.Payload.WiFi](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Payload.WiFi.md): WiFi network payload builder.
- [Qiroex.QR](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.QR.md): Core QR code generation pipeline.
- [Qiroex.Render.PNG](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Render.PNG.md): Renders a QR code as a PNG binary.
- [Qiroex.Render.SVG](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Render.SVG.md): Renders a QR code as an SVG string.
- [Qiroex.Render.Terminal](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Render.Terminal.md): Renders a QR code to the terminal using Unicode block characters.
- [Qiroex.Scanability](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Scanability.md): Scanability scoring for generated QR codes.
- [Qiroex.Spec](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Spec.md): ISO/IEC 18004 specification lookup tables for QR code generation.
- [Qiroex.Style](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Style.md): Visual styling configuration for QR code rendering.
- [Qiroex.Validate](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Validate.md): Input validation for QR code options and parameters.
- [Qiroex.Version](https://qiroex.hexdocs.pm/Qiroex.Version.md): QR code version selection and capacity checking.
